constraints.description: All 18 retained ADRs are uniquely indexed with valid dates, status, and supersession.
Seven selected reversals preserve both the prior position and its current replacement.
Raw Prometheus, KBD, wiki, machine, credential, key, and event content does not enter public output.
Historical records are not presented as current product behavior or cross-profile evidence.

validation.validation_method: history, truth, architecture, and publication validation

constraints.description: The review makes no production-build, browser, accessibility, deployment, or runtime claim.

global_rules: Current source and canonical specifications outrank historical narrative.
termination_conditions: All blocking constraints pass their observed local controls.
No runtime, application, dependency, lockfile, workflow, route, vendor, submodule, or raw-history edit remains.
